articles.title: No Eclipse Glasses? Try a Colander!
articles.summary: Can't find eclipse glasses? You can use a colander or a pinhole projector to watch Wednesday's eclipse safely. Here's how!

articles.title: Trump Says Pro-Israel Groups Have Less Power in Congress
articles.summary: President Trump says pro-Israel lobbying groups don't have as much power in Congress as they used to. He also made comments about Senator Schumer that upset many people.

articles.title: Peggy Flanagan Wins Big in Minnesota Primary
articles.summary: Peggy Flanagan won the Democratic primary for Senate in Minnesota, beating a more moderate candidate. She's a progressive who wants to fight corporate influence.
